entities.name: building
entities.description: A structure with a roof and walls, used as a place of shelter or for other purposes, such as educational facilities or residential homes.

entities.name: site plan
entities.description: A detailed architectural plan illustrating the layout of buildings, landscaping, and other features on a specific property or development site.

entities.name: ordinance
entities.description: A law or regulation enacted by a city or municipal government, often related to land use, zoning, or building codes.

entities.name: setbacks
entities.description: The minimum distance that a building or other structure must be set back from property lines, streets, or other structures as specified by local zoning laws.

entities.name: neighborhood
entities.description: A geographically localized community within a city, often characterized by residential areas, local amenities, and shared community interests.

entities.name: parking
entities.description: Designated areas or facilities for the parking of vehicles, including regulations, spaces, and management.

entities.name: community
entities.description: A group of people living in the same area or sharing common interests, often involved in local activities and civic matters.
